description: This file defines the interface ProgramWorkflowDAO, which provides database access methods for managing Program, PatientProgram, ConceptStateConversion, and related entities within the OpenMRS system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, retrieval by various parameters, and associations between concepts and workflows.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database operations related to Program, PatientProgram, and ConceptStateConversion management in OpenMRS.

methods.name: saveProgram
methods.description: Saves or updates a Program object in the database.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its primary key (programId).

methods.name: getAllPrograms
methods.description: Returns all Program entities, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: findPrograms
methods.description: Searches for Programs matching a name fragment.

methods.name: deleteProgram
methods.description: Removes a Program from the database.

methods.name: savePatientProgram
methods.description: Persists a PatientProgram, creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: getPatientProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgram by its primary key.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms
methods.description: Fetches PatientPrograms based on cohort and program collection.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms
methods.description: Retrieves PatientPrograms based on various optional filters such as patient, program, dates, and voided status.

methods.name: deletePatientProgram
methods.description: Deletes a PatientProgram from the database.

methods.name: saveConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Saves or updates a ConceptStateConversion entity.

methods.name: getAllConceptStateConversions
methods.description: Returns all ConceptStateConversion entities.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion by its primary key.

methods.name: deleteConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Removes a ConceptStateConversion from the database.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Fetches a ConceptStateConversion matching a ProgramWorkflow and Concept.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion by its UUID.

methods.name: getPatientProgramByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgram by UUID.

methods.name: getProgramByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by UUID.

methods.name: getProgramsByName
methods.description: Fetches Programs matching a given name, with optional inclusion of retired.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState by its primary key.

methods.name: getStateByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientStateByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientState by UUID.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow by its primary key.

methods.name: getWorkflowByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow by UUID.

methods.name: getProgramsByConcept
methods.description: Gets list of Programs associated with a specific Concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowsByConcept
methods.description: Gets list of ProgramWorkflows associated with a specific Concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowStatesByConcept
methods.description: Gets list of ProgramWorkflowStates associated with a specific Concept.

methods.name: getAllProgramAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all ProgramAttributeType entities.

methods.name: getProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getProgramAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProgramAttributeType.

methods.name: getPatientProgramAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgramAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: purgeProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a ProgramAttributeType.

methods.name: getPatientProgramByAttributeNameAndValue
methods.description: Retrieves PatientPrograms by attribute name and value.

methods.name: getPatientProgramAttributeByAttributeName
methods.description: Returns a map of patient IDs to attribute values for a given attribute name.
